properties.displayName: [Baseline] Virtual machines may only use approved SKUs
properties.description: Denies virtual machines whose size is not on the approved SKU list. Constraining sizes prevents surprise spend from oversized or GPU SKUs and keeps the fleet on families the organization has benchmarked, licensed, and budgeted for.

metadata.description: The effect the policy applies when a virtual machine uses an unapproved SKU.
Virtual machine sizes that may be deployed.
